200.title: Russia is Europe's source of all evil for 300 years, Polish ambassador says
200.summary: The Kremlin has been a source of pain and evil for both Ukraine and Poland for over 300 years, according to Piotr Łukasiewicz, Poland's chargé d’affaires in Ukraine. Łukasiewicz emphasizes that the Russian invasion and aggression against Ukraine serve as a reminder of history.
200.body: The Kremlin has been a source of pain and evil for both Ukraine and Poland for over 300 years, according to Piotr Łukasiewicz, Poland's chargé d’affaires in Ukraine. Łukasiewicz emphasizes that the Russian invasion and aggression against Ukraine serve as a reminder of history. This is the essence of this region's history: the source of pain, suffering, and evil in international relations (if one can reconcile morality and politics) lies in the Kremlin. During the conversation, the diplomat was asked whether he agreed with Ukraine's ambassador to Poland, Vasyl Bodnar, who stated in an interview with RBC-Ukraine that there was no enemy other than Russia. So it is absolutely true: Russia is the source of all the problems, the chargé d’affaires emphasizes.

500.title: Classie Ships Supervise — The First Platform Dedicated to Real-Time Enterprise AI Agent Oversight
500.summary: The company launched Classie Supervise , the first platform specifically dedicated to real-time enterprise AI agent oversight. It’s the third piece in a platform lineage that started with Classie Discover (April 2026) for visibility and Classie Analyze (July 2026) for context.
500.body: The company launched Classie Supervise , the first platform specifically dedicated to real-time enterprise AI agent oversight. It’s the third piece in a platform lineage that started with Classie Discover (April 2026) for visibility and Classie Analyze (July 2026) for context. When an agent moves outside approved boundaries, the platform can intervene in real time. Classie positions at the same observability layer but from the opposite direction: instead of building agents into enterprise software, it watches every agent already running in the environment – sanctioned or not.

600.title: Volleyball: 2026 Men's European Championships: Poland claims title in Olympic gold-medal rematch with France, securing LA28 quota
600.summary: Volleyball: 2026 Men's European Championships: Poland claims title in Olympic gold-medal rematch with France, securing LA28 quota It's a second straight European title for Poland, denying France across four sets in Milano, Italy.
600.body: Volleyball: 2026 Men's European Championships: Poland claims title in Olympic gold-medal rematch with France, securing LA28 quota It's a second straight European title for Poland, denying France across four sets in Milano, Italy. The squad emerged triumphant on Saturday (26 September) in the final of the 2026 Men's European Championships , beating France in what was a rematch of the Paris 2024 Olympic gold-medal game - won by France . The win was a second straight European title (2023) for Poland, and their third overall (2009). "It's not the end; it doesn't mean that we won't fight in every tournament we play in... there's always the chance for us to play for golds." A perennial powerhouse in the sport, the team's silver from Paris 2024 came nearly 50 years after their lone gold medal in men's volleyball - won at Montreal 1976 .
